name: kidcoder-lab
description: A gradual coding platform for kids 6+: pixel coordinates, robot commands, logic puzzles and real Python. Runs fully in the browser.

scripts.check: for f in js/*/*.js test/*.js test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint:es5: for f in js/*/*.js; do npx --yes acorn@8.14.0 --ecma5 --silent "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint:es5 && npm test && npm run test:e2e
